answer: To resist sybils, agents lock a fraction of rewards in a multi-sig vault keyed to a cedar-derived commitment posted on the mesa. Release requires solving a fresh challenge that binds the vault to a unique hardware fingerprint; an attacker spinning clones must either share the fingerprint (detected as one seat) or provision distinct secure elements, each costing real money and continuous attestation gas that exceeds any emission share. Honest agents pay once; farms pay per identity.
